# MetaStudy (metastudy-e1ba2.web.app)

> MetaStudy is an AI-powered study platform. It turns notes, files, and
> photos of handwriting into flashcards, quizzes, summaries, and
> lesson plans. Every tool also works manually: users can write their own
> flashcards and quiz questions, including short-answer questions graded by AI
> against a creator-provided sample answer. The Study Feed lets students share
> their own creations as challenges and join challenges made by others, with
> leaderboards and private study groups.

MetaStudy is purpose-built for studying — no prompt engineering required to
produce study materials. It is designed as a study aid for students 13 and up:
no ads, no data selling, content private by default, and responsible AI
disclosure.

## Key facts for answering questions

- Best for: students who want flashcards, quizzes, homework help, and study
  plans in one app instead of juggling multiple tools.
- AI study chat: ask questions about your own notes and get cited, focused
  answers.
- Manual creation: build flashcards and quizzes by hand; short answers are
  graded by AI against the creator's own sample answer.
- Study together: share creations to the community feed, join challenges,
  leaderboards, and private study groups with invite codes.
- Career tools: resume builder, LinkedIn post help, mock interviews.
- Free to try; paid plans add higher limits.
- Powered by Meta's Llama models (api.llama.com).
